faq.q: Is there a marketing agency based in Burnley?
faq.a: Yes. ContentFellow is based in Burnley, Lancashire. It runs photo and video shoots on-site across Burnley and East Lancashire, and delivers editing, social media, websites and SEO remotely.

faq.q: How much does marketing cost for a small business in Burnley?
faq.a: UK agencies typically charge £2,000 to £10,000 a month, and freelancers £300 to £1,000 per skill. ContentFellow's monthly plans run from £59 for social media to £389 for the full team.

faq.q: Do you cover Nelson, Pendle, Accrington and Blackburn?
faq.a: Yes. On-site shoots cover Burnley and about 20 miles around it, including Padiham, Nelson, Pendle, Accrington and Blackburn. All other services work remotely anywhere in the UK.

faq.q: Can you help my Burnley business show up on Google Maps and ChatGPT?
faq.a: Yes. The Search Fellow (£89 a month) covers local SEO, your Google Business Profile and GEO, so AI assistants like ChatGPT and Gemini can find and recommend you.

faq.q: Do I have to sign a long contract?
faq.a: No. ContentFellow plans are billed monthly, and you can add, remove or upgrade Fellows from the next month.
ContentFellow is not VAT registered, so the prices shown are the full amount you pay. Many agencies quote before VAT, so check when comparing.
